content: SQLite additive migrations: no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, so check pragma table_info(table) first and only then issue ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN; ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with a NOT NULL DEFAULT is allowed and does not rewrite logical row values. Idempotency and byte-level no-op on second boot require the migration to avoid touching existing rows and to avoid bumping any revision/updated_at columns; a migration that rewrites a shared JSON document breaks a 'second boot is a no-op' snapshot test because doc and updated_at differ between boots.
